page.overview:
Who is Cima?

When first speaks to , she complains about how nervous makes her when it strikes the . Since she can not figure out the reason, she asks to figure out why it is struck so often. will be happy if he accepts, which initiates the "" .

On top of , can find a . After taking it, can return to to inform her of his discovery. She realizes that the must have been drawing the to the and wonders if it was put up there on purpose. She thanks for his help, giving him a as a reward. is relieved to finally be able to relax. This completes the .

Afterwards, if speaks to , she will ask if he has seen the leading into . She claims each one is unique and worth seeing. While she is going to sleep, she tells to wait for whatever he needs until tomorrow.
